subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a built-in Control UI cron calendar/timeline view now, and should the open linked implementation be repaired, replaced, or closed?
rationale: This is a new user-facing Control UI mode rather than a broken documented behavior, and the open linked PR implements only part of the requested scope while now conflicting with current UI architecture.

options.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Use the linked PR or a replacement branch for a scheduler-accurate read-only 24-hour timeline first, while tracking day/week/editing behavior separately.

options.title: Scope Full Calendar Plan
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define daily, weekly, heatmap, popup, validator, and drag-and-drop rescheduling behavior as one product plan.

options.title: Decline Core Calendar View
options.body: Keep the current list/run-history UI as the core surface and close the issue plus linked PR if maintainers decide a calendar view is not wanted in core.

recommendation.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR or a replacement branch for a scheduler-accurate read-only 24-hour timeline first, while tracking day/week/editing behavior separately.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current routing signal from recent cron Control UI file ownership and prior product-review context.
